company.name: BioAge Labs
company.shortDescription: BioAge Labs is a clinical-stage biotechnology company that develops therapeutics to treat obesity and metabolic diseases.
company.description: BIOAGE discovers and develops drugs to treat aging and associated diseases. The company's primary initiative, azelaprag, is an oral APJ agonist on track for Phase 2 trials in conjunction with tirzepatide to potentially become a groundbreaking treatment for obesity in the elderly.

productsAndServices.description: An investigational oral NLRP3 inhibitor intended to reduce chronic inflammation associated with cardiovascular risk and metabolic dysfunction.
productsAndServices.name: BGE-102

productsAndServices.description: An investigational obesity treatment program that activates the apelin receptor APJ to support weight loss and body-composition improvement, including in combination with incretin therapies.
productsAndServices.name: Apelin/APJ Agonist Program

productsAndServices.description: A drug-discovery platform that analyzes proprietary, longitudinal multi-omics data to identify molecular targets and therapeutic programs associated with human aging and metabolic disease.
productsAndServices.name: Human-First Discovery Platform

aiResearchSummary.text: BioAge Labs is researching methods of treating diseases and conditions associated with weight gain and obesity by using apelin receptor agonists alone, or with satiety-inducing or GLP one receptor agonist agents, as described in Methods of treating a disease or condition associated with weight gain and Combination therapy of apelin receptor agonist and glp one receptor agonist for weight loss. Overall, they develop apelin based metabolic weight loss therapies.
